script: To celebrate the 50th anniversary of the ABA-NBA merger, the ABA is releasing throwback jerseys of the ABA teams that joined the NBA in 1976. Those teams were the Denver Nuggets, Indiana Pacers, New York Nets, now known as the Brooklyn Nets, and San Antonio Spurs. The Nets are bringing back the classic white with bright red lettering. The Nuggets are bringing back their iconic orange and black rocket-era colors. The Pacers are giving us indie 500 threads with track peeling off to the side of the jersey. And the Spurs are bringing back their classic red, white, and blue court, along with their clean grey jerseys. They also created a really fun animation to introduce their jerseys.
